A 1.5-kilogram block is pushed rapidly and released. The block continues to slide some distance until it comes to a stop. The figure shows the block after it has been released and before it comes to a stop.

Name the forces that directly affect the block's motion both before and after the block has been released. Describe the effects of each force named.
instruction: Enter your answer in the box.
